zh-CN.title: 奖励轨道不再带动页面
items: 自动展映只滚动底部奖励轨道，不再滚动全屏页面祖先
第四项奖励居中时页面保持在原位
全屏成长仪式增加严格的横向边界约束

en.title: The reward rail no longer shifts the page
items: Autoplay now scrolls only the reward rail instead of its fullscreen ancestors
The page remains anchored when the fourth reward is centered
The growth ceremony now enforces strict horizontal viewport boundaries
